title: Aquarius: Cosmic Waves Are Coming
youtube_description: Discover how the week’s key transits will reshape your love life and boost your career. From Mercury’s career boost to Venus’s romantic trine, I break it all down for you. Comment your sign for your personalized reading!

captions_structure.text: Brace yourself, Aquarius—Uranus’s winds will reshape your sky.

script_text: Brace yourself, Aquarius—Uranus’s winds will reshape your sky. Monday’s Mercury sextile Jupiter in your 10th House sharpens career talk, making it a professional day. Tuesday’s Sun opposing Uranus in your 4th House sparks home drama, marking Tuesday as your toughest day. Wednesday’s Venus trine Neptune in your 7th House ignites love harmony, making Wednesday your power day. Mid-week, Saturn stations direct in your 2nd House, shifting focus to disciplined finance and stabilising money. Thursday’s Pluto inconjunct Mars in your 5th House ramps up creative tension. Friday’s Moon in Aquarius squares Mercury, stirring restless thoughts. Weekend welcomes Jupiter entering your 1st House, boosting confidence and social opportunities. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Neptune in your 7th House. Tuesday is your toughest day as Sun opposes Uranus in 4th House. Schedule a morning meditation to anchor Air currents and stay grounded. Follow for daily updates.
